route_reassessment.replacement: Use officially published public dRPC for the exact same native Ethereum receipt method and transaction; normal TLS/DNS, no credential or account.
route_reassessment.feasibility_evidence: Three ordered read-only diagnostic controls passed the unchanged native receipt/block validators, including cross-provider block identity. A default-sandbox DNS failure and its sole explicit network correction remain recorded; the lower-level DNS cause is not asserted.

route_reassessment.stop_condition: Any corrective command failure, response conflict, completeness issue or resource limit stops dependencies and is preserved in the same gate.
